rows.Primary Promise: Connect body structure and daily physiology into one long-term health picture.

rows.Primary Promise: Know what your body is made of, not just what you weigh.
rows.Core Proof: Product-guideline claim: do not position as diagnostic; use trend and composition language.
rows.Key Benefits: Turns ambiguous weight changes into clearer body-composition feedback.
rows.Key Features: 8-sensor measurement, segmental composition, body fat, muscle mass, hydration and trend tracking.
rows.Primary Desired Outcomes: Lose fat while preserving muscle; understand plateaus; see progress beyond weight.
rows.Primary Problems: Scale weight hides fat, muscle, hydration and distribution changes.
rows.Product Mechanism: Hand-and-foot, multi-frequency BIA with segmental body composition trends.
